The Sword of Justice }} '''Roshan City''' (Japanese: '''ローシャン''' ''Rōshan'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Unova]]. It is one of the settings of ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''. Roshan City is a sprawling city accessible by train. Underneath the city are disused subway tunnels, and one of the old stations has been transformed into a museum for old transportation devices. A train track that leads to Roshan City connects it with [[Windy Station]] and probably other locations as well. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} took the train to Roshan City and on their way met an injured {{mov|Keldeo|Keldeo|15}}. When they arrived in Roshan City, they immediately took it to the city's [[Pokémon Center]]. The [[Nurse Joy]] there told them more about Keldeo and the [[Swords of Justice]]. After Keldeo was healed, Ash, {{an|Iris}}, {{an|Cilan}} took Keldeo outside and ate dinner with it. Shortly afterwards, they were attacked by a group of {{p|Cryogonal}}, which were sent by {{mov|Kyurem|Kyurem|15}}. A wild chase followed, continuing through the city's disused subway tunnels, until Ash and his friends managed to escape the city with a blimp from Roshan City's museum of old transportation devices. ==Trivia== ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Roshan City is modeled after various locations in {{wp|Tokyo}}, such as the {{wp|Special wards of Tokyo|special wards}} of {{wp|Shinjuku}} and {{wp|Shinagawa}} along with the waterfront district of {{wp|Tennōzu Isle}}[http://www.oricon.co.jp/entertainment/interview/2012/pokemon0711/index2.html Interview with Kōichi Yamadera and Director Kunihiko Yuyama]{{dead link}} on Oricon ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150729235333/http://www.oricon.co.jp/entertainment/interview/2012/pokemon0711/index2.html archived]) (Japanese).
